arxiv-1803-00408.title: Quantum models based on finite groups
arxiv-1803-00408.creator: Vladimir V Kornyak
arxiv-1803-00408.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Vladimir V Kornyak. We consider a constructive modification of quantum-mechanical formalism. Replacement of a general unitary group by unitary representations of finite groups makes it possible to reproduce quantum formalism without loss of its empirical content. Since any linear representation of a finite group can be implemented as a subrepresentation of a permutation representation, quantum-mechanical problems can be formulated in terms of permutation groups.

arxiv-2110-14764.creator: Alejandro Moreo, Andrea Pedrotti, Fabrizio Sebastiani
arxiv-2110-14764.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alejandro Moreo, Andrea Pedrotti, Fabrizio Sebastiani. Funnelling ( Fun ) is a recently proposed method for cross-lingual text classification (CLTC) based on a two-tier learning ensemble for heterogeneous transfer learning (HTL). In this ensemble method, 1st-tier classifiers, each working on a different and language-dependent feature space, return a vector of calibrated posterior probabilities (with one dimension for each class) for each document, and the final classification decision is taken by a meta-classifier that uses this vector as its input.

arxiv-2203-14323.title: On quantum free-electron laser: Superradience
arxiv-2203-14323.creator: Alexander Iomin
arxiv-2203-14323.description: Abstract A quantum model of a free-electron laser is considered for the many electron system. An exact expression for the evolution of the laser amplitude is obtained in the framework of the coherent state consideration. Reliable conditions for the superradiance of the high-gained laser is discussed for the short time limit of the exact solution. pacs 2.50.-p, 42.55.-f, 3.65.

arxiv-2504-18327.title: Diffraction of fast heavy noble gas atoms, Ar, Kr and Xe on a LiF(001) surface Changing the tip of a ’perfect’ AFM
arxiv-2504-18327.creator: M. Debiossac, P. Pan, C. Kanitz, P. Roncin
arxiv-2504-18327.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by M. Debiossac, P. Pan, C. Kanitz, P. Roncin. We investigate experimentally the diffraction of fast atoms of noble gas on a LiF(100) crystal oriented along the [100] and [110] directions. The wavelengths are so short that the observed quantum features are qualitatively described by semi-classical models. With increasing mass and energy, the scattering profiles show an increasing number of diffraction peaks forming an increasing number of supernumerary rainbow peaks but progressively weakening in contrast. The innermost peaks corresponding to individual Bragg peaks disappear first.

arxiv-2509-12324.title: VADER: A Variational Autoencoder to Infer Planetary Masses and Gas-Dust Disk Properties Around Young Stars
arxiv-2509-12324.creator: Sayed Shafaat Mahmud, Sayantan Auddy, Neal Turner, Jeffrey S. Bary
arxiv-2509-12324.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sayed Shafaat Mahmud, Sayantan Auddy, Neal Turner, Jeffrey S. Bary. We present VADER (Variational Autoencoder for Disks Embedded with Rings), for inferring both planet mass and global disk properties from high-resolution ALMA dust continuum images of protoplanetary disks (PPDs). VADER, a probabilistic deep learning model, enables uncertainty-aware inference of planet masses, α \alpha -viscosity, dust-to-gas ratio, Stokes number, flaring index, and the number of planets directly from protoplanetary disk images.

arxiv-2602-14124.creator: Narges Tarakameh Samani, Farhad Shahbazi, Mehdi Abdi
arxiv-2602-14124.description: Abstract Controlling nonlinear effects in micro– and nano-electro-mechanical systems is essential for unlocking their full potential in sensing, signal processing, and frequency control. In this study, we develop a voltage-dependent Hamiltonian framework for a nanoelectromechanical resonator with two strongly coupled vibrational modes, representative of a nanostring platform.
